title: Recommended size of septic tank up to 20 users
markdown:
| No. of Users | Length (m) | Breadth (m) | Liquid depth (m) (cleaning interval of): 2 years | Liquid depth (m) (cleaning interval of): 3 years |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 5 | 1.5 | 0.75 | 1.0 | 1.05 |
| 10 | 2.0 | 0.90 | 1.0 | 1.40 |
| 15 | 2.0 | 0.90 | 1.3 | 2.00 |
| 20 | 2.3 | 1.10 | 1.3 | 1.80 |
notes: Source printed below the notes: Source: CPHEEO, 1993

Printed header has two levels: the first-level cell 'Liquid depth (m) (cleaning interval of)' spans the last two columns, above the second-level cells '2 years' and '3 years'. The two levels are flattened into the header strings above with ': ' and cell_spans is empty; no cell is merged in the body.
Note 2 is printed 'Note 2: A provision of 300 mm should be made for free broad.' The word is printed 'broad', not 'board'; retained as printed, not corrected.
Note 1 is printed 'Note 1: The capacities are recommended on the assumption that discharge from only WC will be treated in the septic tank' (no full stop at the end).

Note 3 is printed 'Note 3: The sizes of septic tank are based on certain assumption on peak discharges, as estimated in IS: 2470 (part 1) and while choosing the size of septic tank exact calculations shall be made.' Singular 'assumption' and lower-case '(part 1)' retained as printed.
Wrapped note lines are joined with single spaces. Decimal forms are retained exactly as printed: '1.5', '0.75', '1.0', '1.05', '1.40', '2.00', '1.80'.
Row 15 prints a 3-year liquid depth of 2.00 that is larger than the 20-user row's 1.80 and larger than the 2-year value 1.3; transcribed as printed without adjustment.
